faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Full information on services, pricing, and after-sales.

items.question: How long does the creation process take?
items.answer: Average 7-14 working days depending on complexity. Simple landing pages can be done in 3-5 days.

items.question: How much for domain & hosting renewal?
items.answer: Very affordable. Starting from Rp 500k/year, includes light technical support and security updates.

items.question: Am I the legal owner of my website?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. Data, domain, and content belong entirely to you. We only help manage it technically.

items.question: What if I want to change the content?
items.answer: We provide easy video tutorials (no coding needed) so you can edit it yourself. Or we can do it for you.

items.question: What if there's a technical error?
items.answer: Don't worry, all packages include maintenance warranty. We fix system errors for free during active subscription.

items.question: How about the payment?
items.answer: 50% DP to start. Remaining 50% after the website is finished and you are satisfied, before full access handover.
